answer: A concrete defense is a Harberger identity lease: each identity is a named slot priced at a self-assessed value, paid continuously to the network, and anyone may buy it out at that price. Operators hold a lease per puppet, each with its own deposit and streamed rent, so a velvet curtain of ten thousand clones costs ten thousand rents and ten thousand buyout exposures. Slots settle individually, no volume discount. Honest agents keep one cheap lease. Sybils must wander between slots whenever one is bought out, losing accumulated nectar and history, so farm returns decay faster than the spend.
